name: Miniforce
overview: Four animal superheroes called the Miniforce transform into robots to protect small and defenseless creatures from the hands of scheming villains.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Together, Volt the squirrel, Max the beaver, Sammy the owl, and Lucy the fox are part of an animal agent organization known as the Miniforce. Normally, they live under the care of a human named Suzy. But when the Big Bads Nein and Pascal plot trouble and carry out evil plans around their peaceful area, our heroes come to the rescue.

seasons.name: Miniforce X Season 1
seasons.overview: Zenos, a cosmic villain who was once defeated by space cops, sets back in Asteroid Crete and waits for his time. Hundreds of years later, a space pirate gang DanDanDan (Kara, Dante, and Dancho) finds Zenos. Zenos lost most of his power but manages to escape Crete by offering a sweet promise to DanDanDan. The Miniforce will have to stop him once and for all!
